:::{#rem-cumulative-incidence}
#### Cumulative incidence has a second meaning

The name **cumulative incidence** for the [risk](#def-risk-epi)
fits a closed population,
where no one enters or leaves after the start of the time period
[@me4, Chapter 4].
The same name is also used for a different quantity:
when several event types compete,
the [cumulative incidence function](proportional-hazards-models.qmd#def-cumulative-incidence)
of one event type at time $t$
is the probability that this type of event occurs by time $t$
[@me4, Chapter 22].
This chapter uses the name only for the risk of a [binary outcome](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/data.html#def-binary-var).
:::
